handover_report.title: EverythingAI Phase 8.2 CI Smoke Test Integration Completion Handover
handover_report.prepared_for: Next AI engineering agent / continuation session

repository.name: everythingAI
repository.working_branch_policy: All work happens directly on main unless the user explicitly changes this rule.

executive_summary.project_identity: EverythingAI is a local-first, source-backed AI knowledge workspace and file intelligence platform that indexes scoped local files, extracts content, builds durable Knowledge Base / Wiki views, generates governed planning suggestions, supports safe file organization, and separates normal Client Workspace usage from Admin Dashboard operations.
executive_summary.current_state: Phase 8.2 CI Smoke Test Integration is complete. The current verified baseline is 113 backend tests passing, frontend typecheck PASS, frontend build PASS, and CI smoke-test integration implemented through .github/workflows/ci-smoke.yml.
executive_summary.latest_validated_result: Backend npm test passed with 113 tests and 0 failures. Frontend npm run typecheck passed. Frontend npm run build passed. Playwright smoke coverage is included in the CI pipeline.
executive_summary.recommended_next_focus: Proceed to Phase 8.3: connector-specific setup/testing for installed Codex and Claude Code, continued release hardening, frontend modularization, API key lifecycle UX, and richer citation/source formatting.

security_and_governance_invariants_prese: Client Workspace and Admin Dashboard separation is preserved.
Client Workspace must not expose provider selection, API keys, or Agent Connector settings.
Agent bridge execution remains disabled by default.
Agent chat execution remains disabled by default.
Arbitrary shell command execution remains blocked.
current_capabilities: Client Workspace with Home, Sources & Files, Knowledge Base, and Ask AI.
Admin Dashboard with Dashboard, Files & Content, Planning, Ask AI, Analytics, and Settings.
Admin-only AI Provider Configuration with broad provider catalog.
Admin-only Agent Connectors panel and backend connector catalog.
Connector detection and controlled version probes for installed connectors.
CI smoke-test pipeline for backend tests, frontend typecheck/build, and Playwright smoke test.
Playwright report and test result artifacts documented for CI.
known_limitations_and_followups: OpenCode, Kilo Code, and Cline are not installed or not on PATH in the current connector state.
Connector-specific setup/testing remains needed for installed Codex and Claude Code before relying on real connector workflows.
Agent bridge chat remains disabled unless EVERYTHINGAI_AGENT_BRIDGE_ENABLED=true and EVERYTHINGAI_AGENT_CHAT_ENABLED=true are intentionally set in the backend environment.
Frontend admin files still include a legacy AdminAppV2 path; controlled modular cleanup remains recommended.
AnythingLLM remains optional/not configured unless the user intentionally installs and connects it.
OpenDataLoader PDF remains a future optional extraction connector candidate only if it adds clear new extraction functionality beyond the current extractor.

recommended_next_actions.task: Controlled connector-specific setup/testing for installed Codex and Claude Code.
recommended_next_actions.validation: Verify connector-specific behavior, safety flags, and disabled-by-default execution without exposing connectors to Client Workspace.

recommended_next_actions.task: Continue release hardening and frontend modularization.
recommended_next_actions.validation: After each cleanup, run frontend typecheck/build and Playwright smoke test.

recommended_next_actions.task: Improve API key lifecycle UX and citation/source formatting.
recommended_next_actions.validation: Validate with backend tests, frontend typecheck/build, and smoke coverage where UI behavior changes.

startup_instructions_for_next_agent: Read this handover first before making changes.
Confirm repo is on main and clean with git status.
Use docs/VALIDATION_2026-06-13_PHASE8_2_CI_SMOKE_COMPLETION.md as the current Phase 8.2 validation reference.
Do not expose provider/API-key settings or Agent Connectors in Client Workspace.
Do not change trust-score or quality-score calculations.
Do not enable agent bridge execution or agent chat execution by default.
After backend changes, run npm test in services/api.
After frontend changes, run npm run typecheck and npm run build in apps/everything-ai-ui.
For UI changes, run npx playwright test smoke/client-admin-smoke.spec.ts from apps/everything-ai-ui.
